senses.gloss:
युक् युक् (?) or युत् (?), ind. badly, ill;
(these appear to be wrong forms.)

युक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, yoked, joined, united, con-
nected, attached, fastened, harnessed; used, em-
ployed, prepared, fitted out, arranged, ready, arranged
in regular order, adapted, fitted, fit, suitable, just,
proper, right, moderate, due, (युक्तः कालेन यः,
one who makes use of the right opportunity; आयति-
युक्त, suitable or profitable for the future); ap-
pointed, engaged, occupied; fixed on, intent on
(with loc. or at the end of a comp.); occupied with,
immersed in, engaged in, absorbed in, attentive,
attached to, given up or devoted to, absorbed in
abstract meditation or in the religious exercise called
Yoga; exercised in, skilled in, experienced, skilful,
clever; active, energetic; joined with, furnished
with, endowed with, filled with, possessed of, having,
possessing (with inst. or at the end of a comp.);
connected with, relating to; proved, inferred, de-
duced by argument; (in gram.) primitive, i. e. not
derivative; (अम्), ind. collectively, in troops (Ved.);
suitably, properly, rightly, fitly, duly, well; (अस्), m.
a sage or saint who has become united with the
Universal Soul, one who is so absorbed in meditating
on the Supreme Spirit as to be free from all feeling
and passion; N. of a son of Manu Raivata; of one
of the seven Ṛṣis under Manu Bhautya; (आ), f.,
N. of a plant (commonly called Elāni, cf. युक्त-
रसा); (अम्), n. a team, yoke; a measure of four
cubits, (incorrectly for 2. युत.)
—युक्त-कर्मन्,
आ, आ, अ, invested with any office or function, ap-
pointed to any work.
—युक्त-कारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, or
युक्त-कृत्, त्, त्, त्, doing properly or suitably, acting
fitly.
—युक्त-ग्रावन्, आ, आ, अ, Ved. having the
stone (for bruising the Soma) prepared, (Sāy. =
उद्यत-ग्रावन्.)
—युक्त-तम, अस्, आ, अम्, most
fit; most absorbed in or intent on, very much
devoted to.
—युक्त-तर, अस्, आ, अम्, more fit, very
intent on or attentive, very much on one's guard
(Manu VII. 186).
—युक्त-त्व, अम्, n. application,
use, employment; suitableness, fitness, propriety.
—युक्त-दण्ड, अस्, आ, अम्, employing or applying
punishment; punishing justly.
—युक्तदण्ड-ता, f.
the inflicting of just punishment.
—युक्त-मनस्,
[]
आस्, आस्, अस्, ready-minded, fixing the mind, attentive.
—युक्त-मांसल, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. properly stout or
fleshy.
—युक्त-रथ, अस्, m., N. of a particular kind
of cleansing clyster; of a sort of elixir.
—युक्त-रसा,
f. a species of plant (= युक्ता).
—युक्त-रूप, अस्,
आ, अम्, suitably formed, symmetrical, suitable, proper,
fit, moderate; fit for, corresponding to (with loc. or
gen.); (अम्), ind. suitably.
—युक्त-वत्, आन्, अती,
अत्, Ved. containing the verb युज्.
—युक्त-शीतोष्ण
(˚त-उष्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, of moderate cold and heat.
—युक्त-सेन, अस्, आ, अम्, one whose army is ready
(for marching).
—युक्तसेनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, relating
to one whose army is ready for marching.
—युक्ता-
यस् (˚त-अय्˚), अस्, n. ‘bound with iron,’ a sort of
spade or shovel.
—युक्तायुक्त (˚त-अय्˚), अम्, n.
the proper and improper, right and wrong.
—युक्-
तारोहिन् (˚त-आर्˚), ई, इणी, इ, see Pāṇ. VI. 2, 81.
—युक्तार्थ (˚त-अर्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, having mean-
ing, filled with significance, sensible, rational, signi-
ficant.
—युक्ताश्व (˚त-अश्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. hav-
ing yoked horses; consisting of horses, (according
to Sāy. on Ṛg-veda V. 41, 5 = अश्व-सहित, ac-
companied with horses.)

युक्ति, इस्, f. yoking, joining, junction, juncture,
union, connection, combination; putting to, harness-
ing; application, use, employment, practice, usage;
appliance, means, plan, scheme, expedient, (द्रव्य-
युक्तिभिस्, by the appliances of money); trick, con-
trivance, device, stratagem; charm, spell; suitableness,
adaptedness, adjustment, fitness, aptness, propriety,
correctness; skill, dexterity, ingenuity, art; reasoning,
argument, argumentation, inference, induction, deduc-
tion from circumstances; probability, provableness;
reason, ground, motive; (in the drama) connection
of events in the plot, concatenation of incidents, in-
telligent weighing of the circumstances; (in gram.)
connection of words, a sentence; (in law) enumera-
tion of circumstances, specification of place, time,
&c.; (in rhetoric) emblematic or mystical expression
of purpose; supplying an ellipsis; sum, total; mix-
ture or alloying of metals; conjunction (in astro-
nomy); युक्त्या, inst. c. by means of, by virtue of
(at the end of a comp.); by device or stratagem,
cunningly, craftily, cleverly, artfully, skilfully, under
pretext or pretence; properly, suitably, fitly, duly;
युक्तिं कृ, to make arrangements, take measures;
to find a means, discover a remedy; to employ
stratagem.
—युक्ति-कथन, अम्, n. statement of
argument, giving reasons.
—युक्ति-कर, अस्, ई, अम्,
causing fitness, suitable, proper, fit; established,
proved.
—युक्ति-कल्प-तरु, उस्, m. [cf. कल्प-
तरु], ‘Kalpa tree of prosperity,’ N. of a work
ascribed to king Bhoja (describing the virtues and
good qualities that ought to be found in a king's
ministers, army, &c.).
—युक्ति-ज्ञ, अस्, आ, अम्,
knowing the proper application, knowing the means
or remedy; skilled in mixing (substances).
—युक्ति-
तस्, ind. by means of, by virtue of (at the end of a
comp.); by stratagem or craft, craftily, cleverly,
artfully, under some pretence or pretext; in a suitable
manner, properly, fitly, duly, according to propriety
or justice.
—युक्ति-भाषा, f., N. of a work.
—युक्-
ति-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, joined, united, tied; possessing
fitness, full of contrivances or plans, fertile in expe-
dients, ingenious, clever, inventive, able, competent;
furnished with arguments, based on argument, proved.
—युक्तिमत्-त्व, अम्, n. the being based on argu-
ment, the being proved.
—युक्ति-युक्त, अस्, आ, अम्,
possessing fitness or aptness, experienced, expert,
skilful; possessing fitness or reason, suitable, proper,
fit; established, proved.
—युक्ति-शास्त्र, अम्, n. the
science of what is suitable or proper.
—युक्ति-स्नेह-
प्रपूरणी, f., N. of a commentary on the Śāstra-
dīpikā by Rāma-kṛṣṇa Bhaṭṭa, (the work is also
called Siddhānta-candrikā.)

युक्त्वा, ind. having yoked, having joined, having
harnessed; having equipped or furnished; (a form
युङ्क्त्वा is also found.)

यूक यूक, अस्, आ, m. f. (said to be fr. rt. 2.
यु), a louse.
—यूक-देवी, f., N. of a princess.
—यूका-लिक्ष, अम्, n. lice and nits.

यूकर यूकर, see Gaṇa Kṛśāśvādi to Pāṇ.
IV. 2, 80.
